concern_summary: This concern manages selection and clipboard operations specifically within the HTML Text Composer, ensuring the preservation of the user’s selection state.

This concern encompasses functionalities related to the overall management of a composer component for user input, including rendering, handling focus, capturing input for messages, managing suggestions, and enforcing constraints like input length.
This concern involves conditional visibility and access to the message composer based on user permissions and contextual report status.
This concern includes functionalities related to managing focus state on various composable elements, ensuring correct focus handling, assignment, and restoration according to user interactions.
This concern encompasses user interface interactions related to copying content, including setting up keyboard shortcuts and handling the specific action of copying card numbers to the clipboard.
This concern focuses on displaying context menus that allow users to perform actions related to ongoing transactions, especially for money requests, while managing interactions based on user actions.

The Emoji Picker Menu encompasses all functionalities related to the display, filtering, interaction, and selection of emojis, providing a cohesive user experience that includes managing user input and responsive interactions.

This concern focuses on assembling and managing the creation of dynamic lists of menu items that provide users with interactions for various actions, incorporating translations and relevant display attributes.
